Hymn 116: Come, Follow Me
Time Signature: 4/4
Musical Key: E-flat Major
Composer: Samuel McBurney
Lyricist/Text Author: John Nicholson
Category: Prayer and Supplication

This is hymn number 116 titled "Come, Follow Me" from the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints hymnbook. 
It is written in E-flat Major with a 4/4 time signature. 
The music was composed by Samuel McBurney and the lyrics were written by John Nicholson.
This hymn is categorized under: Prayer and Supplication.
